controls.name: C-7d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-18T07:17:06.032Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-18T08:17:06.032Z"
        AND host.name == "canary-1"
        AND event.outcome == "failure"
| STATS total_failed = COUNT(*),
        distinct_src_ips = COUNT_DISTINCT(source.ip),
        distinct_users = COUNT_DISTINCT(user.name),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
| LIMIT 1
